- Signer / authority: who will sign the Master Services Agreement (name, title, email)?
- Target signature window: you mentioned the week of 3/21 — would Tuesday 3/21 or Wednesday 3/22 work?
- Procurement: do you need a PO first or will DocuSign + countersign suffice?
- Day-zero/start date: proposed 3/27 for a phased canary (2-day smoke + weekly ramp).
- Legal items: Laura is on copy for retention/SLA notes; if you need SOW tweaks we can scope them in an addendum.

Attachments: Fjord_MAP_v3.xlsx (MAP), Fjord_Security_QA.pdf (summary).

If you can reply with the signer name and preferred signing day by EOD Thursday (3/16) we’ll lock the DocuSign timing and send the pre-sign checklist.

Thanks,

Thanks — map looks good at a high level. A couple of notes from our side: 

- Procurement will generally want a PO before we process payment. I cc’d procurement so they can confirm lead time; typical turnaround is ~48 business hours once we have the final DocuSign packet.
- Legal: we’ve reviewed the retention/SLA bullets; we may request a 30-day clarification on log retention limits (Laura, feel free to chime in).
- Signing: our VP of Ops (Maya Patel) will be the signer. She’s available on 3/21 afternoon ET or 3/22 morning ET. 3/21 at 2:00pm ET would be ideal for them.
- Start date: 3/27 works, but we need a short (2-business-day) onboarding blackout for our internal infra changes — can you confirm Redwood’s canary support will start without requiring that window?

I’m attaching our vendor intake checklist for your legal/procurement team. If everything is in order we’ll route the signature on 3/21 and aim for PO issuance by 3/23.

Best,

Hi Anna — thanks for the quick reply and the intake doc. Short answers from the CS/onboarding side: 

- Canary plan: we’ll do a rolling canary as discussed — Redwood will run 1 GPU-backed instance for your traffic slice for 48 hours (smoke checks + regressions), then open to full traffic over five business days. We’ll provide a runbook and a rollback trigger list (latency > 2.5x baseline, error rates > 1.5%).
- Blackout window: we can avoid active migrations during your 2-business-day internal change. Our suggested sequence:
  • 3/21: Execute contract (DocuSign) and exchange credentials
  • 3/22–3/23: pre-provisioning and final integration tests (no traffic cutover)
  • 3/27: begin canary (48 hours)

- Signer details: Karthik — please confirm the DocuSign packet names to match ‘Maya Patel — VP Ops’.
- Acceptance criteria: we’ll use the MAP checklist attached as the acceptance gate for canary completion.

Attaching: updated MAP (Fjord_MAP_v3.xlsx) with a canary checklist tab.

Camila Reyes
